code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Unknown code or malformed identifier. `revision_changed`: Continuation revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Detail identity or filter rows contradict required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Network or service error after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Process upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety boundary reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
